feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.0
entry.summary: Polyphonic XY wavetable synthesizer with paths, orbit, dual envelopes, HP/LP filters, two LFOs, an eight-slot modulation matrix and 294 Adventure Kid wavetable sounds.

entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.2.0
entry.summary: Companion to TR-MPC: sends any slot, or the kit's reverb or delay send, out on its own MPC track, sample-aligned with the kit, so MPC's mixer, submixes and insert effects can process it. Needs TR-MPC in the same project.

entry.title: TR-MPC 1.2.0
entry.summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit: each slot plays any of the 49 voices of athousanddetails' 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 (a 606 kick beside an 808 snare and 909 hats), with per-slot level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, one shared reverb, delay and master chain, a randomise module, and a touchscreen skin that reskins each slot to its voice's kit.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.7
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 128 presets.

entry.title: Mini-JV 2.0.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Lucky Dip 1.0.0
entry.summary: A random 16-pad drum-kit builder and inspiration machine: dips into your sample library, fills the pads at random, plays the kit and exports it as an MPC drum program.

entry.title: CW-78 1.3.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-CW-78 CR-78 drum machine: voices modelled from the 1979 service notes, with the preset rhythms. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: CSXXL 1.0.13
entry.summary: A two-layer, 8-voice, polyphonic synth in the spirit of the Yamaha CS-80, written from voice notes and self-built schematics. Slider-only panels over 12 pages, per-key aftertouch, touch ribbon, arpeggiator with an 8-step gate per layer, ring mod, chorus and reverb, 768 factory presets in a named list. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: Crate Digger 2.0.0
entry.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade, region and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into an MPC track, with its own screen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 9W9 1.3.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-9W9 TR-909 drum machine: circuit-modelled kick, snare, toms, rim and clap, with sampled hats, ride and crash (ER-99 derived), as on the original. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 8W8 1.3.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-8W8 TR-808 drum machine: 15 of 16 voices circuit-modelled from the service notes. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 6W6 1.3.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-6W6 TR-606 drum machine: voices fitted against real hardware recordings, with measured-partial hats and cymbal. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: πToniC 1.0.3
entry.summary: A Microtonic-inspired drum machine. πToniC features 8 independent drum voices, each combining filtered noise with a morphing oscillator or WAV sample playback. Its sound engine includes pitch modulation, amplitude envelopes, drive, EQ and individual voice controls. Shared stereo reverb and tempo-synced delay complete the engine.

entry.title: πClideaN 1.3.6
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: Welle 0.2.0
entry.summary: Waldorf Wave emulation running from the original Wave OS - developed by Mookid. Styled faithfully to the original panel. Needs your own Wave OS 1.700 files, uploaded from the Plugin Manager.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.4
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Sonix 0.3.14
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries.

entry.title: Profit-08 2.0.0
entry.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter, and a banks browser with favourites for your own program and bank SysEx dumps. 2.0 adds a native MPC screen with large knobs and Q-Link control of every page.

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.8
entry.summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.6
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 128 presets.

entry.title: MPC Multihead Echo 1.0.3
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with three preamp characters, chorus, tape wear, tempo sync with drift, a spring reverb and a companion screen in the browser.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.5
entry.summary: Puts any Machinemodule tracks, and its reverb and delay sends, on their own MPC return or FX track, so MPC's mixer and effects can process them. Needs Machinemodule in the same project. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: Puts any Machinemodule tracks, and its reverb and delay sends, on their own MPC return or FX track, so MPC's mixer and effects can process them. Needs Machinemodule in the same project. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Machinemodule (Gen2) 1.0.5
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum UW sound engine as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: 16 tracks in one plugin, touchscreen skin, bank and kit lists, Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: you add your own OS file (and optionally your flash image) in the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule 1.0.5
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Euclid 2.0.0
entry.summary: 8-lane Euclidean MIDI sequencer: live pattern circle and lane rows with a play-head, per-lane and global randomise, a drum-mode switch, and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.1
entry.summary: DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.0

entry.title: ALPHA 1.2.1
entry.summary: A granular vocal transformer: pitch and formant move separately, with harmonic shifter, alternator, smear, detune, scale/key TUNE, four modulation slots and 492 factory presets. Put it on an input or an insert and sing or play a voice through it, with or without MIDI. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager G2 0.9.1
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.2.0
entry.summary: Hold 16 Levels on the MPC Sample to play its 16 slots in a scale (8 scales, any root), starting from the sample's own note (MPC's, or heard in the audio when untagged). A SCALE page shows the notes and lights the one you play. Recorded hits keep their notes. Needs the MPC Sample Draw Handler for the page.

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.4.0
entry.summary: The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: Dexed 1.0.8
entry.summary: DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: CTRL MixBus 2.0.1
entry.summary: CTRL Mixbus is a professional stereo mixing and processing effect designed to streamline your workflow across three focused pages. Take control of input gain, stereo width, equalization, precision filtering, dynamic gating, and loudness maximization.

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.3.0
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with a spring tank: 12 head and reverb modes, tape saturation, wow and flutter, tempo sync, live VU.

entry.title: MPC Gateway 1.0.1
entry.summary: One HTTPS address and one login (mpc / mpc until you change it on its Settings page) for every addin's web page. A start page lists the services addins declare (ADDIN_WEB_PORT), each routed behind the password. Runs Caddy beside MPC. Device only by default (reach it through an SSH tunnel); bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.

entry.title: MPC File Browser 1.1.0
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse the device's drives in a web browser, upload and download samples and projects, play audio, edit text files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (login admin / mpcadmin; change it). bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.
